meta.name: deepchem
meta.description: Molecular ML with diverse featurizers and pre-built datasets. Use for property prediction (ADMET, toxicity) with traditional ML or GNNs when you want extensive featurization options and MoleculeNet benchmarks. Best for quick experiments with pre-trained models, diverse molecular representations. For graph-first PyTorch workflows use torchdrug; for benchmark datasets use pytdc.

copy.tagline_en: Predict molecular properties like toxicity from structural data

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 可调用 DeepChem:加载 SMILES、SDF、蛋白质序列等分子数据,把分子转成指纹、描述符或图特征,训练机器学习(含图神经网络)模型做性质预测,并能读取 MoleculeNet 基准数据。
howto.when: 当用户要求加载分子数据(SMILES、SDF、FASTA)、做性质预测(如 ADMET、毒性),或需要 MoleculeNet 基准数据与多种特征化方式时触发。

say.note: 会加载 MoleculeNet 数据并评估。

say.text: 把 'CCO' 转成分子图特征,用 AttentiveFP 预测毒性。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use DeepChem: load molecular data (SMILES, SDF, FASTA), convert molecules into fingerprints, descriptors, or graph features, train machine-learning (including graph neural network) models for property prediction, and read MoleculeNet benchmarks.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to load molecular data (SMILES, SDF, FASTA), predict properties such as ADMET or toxicity, or needs MoleculeNet benchmarks and featurization options.

say_en.text: Load molecules.csv with DeepChem and predict water solubility from SMILES.
say_en.note: It will build a dataset and train a suitable model.

say_en.text: Train a GCN on Tox21 and compute ROC-AUC.
say_en.note: It loads the MoleculeNet task and evaluates.

say_en.text: Featurize 'CCO' as a molecular graph and predict toxicity with AttentiveFP.
say_en.note: Runs the featurizer and GNN workflow.
